How unfortunate for you. [1]But I will be removing this unplanned presence right here and now.

strings.tl: This is the strength of humankind.
I-impossible!! The second Prophet's death is not due until later...
Hearts that care for their companions proved stronger than the fate you believe in... // It is a well-worn phrase, but I can give no other answer.

strings.read:
{1c:1b}{0b:08}【 聖者バルカイル 】{0b:09}

strings.tl: That can't be...
To deny gods and legends: that is the answer I have reached. // Your god, your justice and your truth, we have no more need of them.

You founded the Anoian faith and planted a single universal set of values in people, // you showed the whole world the dream of eternal life, // and all of it was to give humankind the illusion called the 'New World'...

strings.en:
{1c:1b}{0b:08}【 Saint Barkail 】{0b:09}
Illusion... you say?{0c:2b5309fe}
strings.tl: Illusion... you say?

strings.jp:
{0c:51502b581000}{1c:11}{0b:08}{e080} クムラン {e081}{0b:09}
人{e0a2}{e0a3}{e0a4}の理想が存{e08c}することが
悪いことだとは思いません。{1a}ですが、その幻想に縛られ
{e0a6}人{e0a6}人の自由が無くなっては
その理想もただの悪弊となります。{1a}まして、その実{e0a8}のために人の命を
簡単に{e0a9}えたり奪うなど・・・
私達はあなた方を断じて認めません!{0c:2b5809fe}
strings.read:
{0c:51502b581000}{1c:11}{0b:08}【 クムラン 】{0b:09}
人類共通の理想が存在することが
悪いことだとは思いません。{1a}ですが、その幻想に縛られ
個人個人の自由が無くなっては
その理想もただの悪弊となります。{1a}まして、その実現のために人の命を
簡単に与えたり奪うなど・・・
私達はあなた方を断じて認めません!{0c:2b5809fe}
strings.en:
{0c:51502b581000}{1c:11}{0b:08}【 Qumran 】{0b:09}
I do not say it is wrong for humanity to
share an ideal.{1a}But when that illusion binds people and
strips each one of their freedom, the
ideal becomes nothing but a blight.{1a}And to give and take human lives so
lightly in order to achieve it... We will
never accept you!{0c:2b5809fe}
strings.tl: I do not say it is wrong for humanity to share an ideal. // But when that illusion binds people and strips each one of their freedom, the ideal becomes nothing but a blight. // And to give and take human lives so lightly in order to achieve it... We will never accept you!
Is that all you have to say, you enemies of God!
As promised, I will let you fight God. Come, then, to the 'Land of Origin'.
Madness! The light has not yet gone out. They must not be allowed to go!
Of course I have not given up on the coming of the 'New World'. // But I find I wish to test it: this truth they speak of. // [1]Besides, that one has earned the right.

strings.en:
{1c:1b}{0b:08}【 Saint Barkail 】{0b:09}
And yet...{0c:2b5709fe}
strings.tl: And yet...

Liar...{0c:2b5109fe}
strings.tl: Liar...
P-Peta...?
Hanna's dead... // You lied, big brother... You said you'd save her for sure...
Peta!!!
H-Hanna's dead...? Wh-what do you mean!?
That fool of a boy, I tell you... Not so much as a single letter...
Priest-sama...?
If I had known, I would never have let him go... // It is too cruel to poor Hanna, is it not...
Priest-sama, I sent the medicine! I did send it!!
H-Hanna...?
Big brother... It hurt... It hurt so much... // [1]Big brother... Why weren't you there with me?
Hanna!!!
Big brother... I'm lonely... It's all dark... I'm scared...
Hanna!!!
Why... After Sadiya-san went to all that trouble making the medicine... // [1]After everybody helped me...
Would you not like to see your sister once more?
Huh...
In the 'New World', [1]neither time nor space exists... // There are no borders dividing one from another, and no sickness or death to torment mankind...
If you wish to begin again, [1]you may begin again freely, from any time you choose.

うそだ! おれは騙されないぞ!{0c:2b5709fe}
strings.en:
{1c:29}{0b:08}【 Ash 】{0b:09}
That's a lie! You won't fool me!{0c:2b5709fe}
strings.tl: That's a lie! You won't fool me!
Do you fear losing your body? The body is but a chain that binds the soul. // Only by severing that chain can one at last gain true freedom, unbound by the fear of death and age.
N-no!! That's a lie!
Why do you deny it? You, more than anyone, long for the coming of the 'New World'.
I made up my mind to fight alongside [HERO]!!
The real me isn't the person you think I am.
Think about it. [1]Who'd ever open up to a simple-minded country hick like you?
The real me is not the person you think I am.
Think it over calmly. [1]Who do you suppose would open up to a simple-minded country hick like you?
Th-that's something [HERO] would never say!!
That's a lie. [1]Really, you're so uneasy you can hardly stand it.
When I'm with [HERO], [1]it kinda feels like I'm being used, and I've hated that for a long time. // I'm dumb, but I knew that much. [HERO] doesn't care about me at all...

{0c:52e0e8}{1c:28}{0b:08}【 Ash 】{0b:09}

strings.tl: You must know by now. [1]There can be no true peace in this world. // [2]But in the 'New World', all can understand one another. The shells around people vanish, and all can become one...

In the 'New World', [1]you will meet your beloved sister again. // And you and everyone will understand one another from the bottom of your hearts. // [2]Come, make your wish. Wish for the coming of the 'New World'!
B-but...
Big brother, [1]won't you play with me anymore? Can't we all play together anymore?
H-Hanna!!
Ngh... Aaaaagh!!
Prophet, awaken! Open the door of the 'New World'!!
So long... Ten thousand years I have waited...
Now at last true eternity... true peace shall be ours...
N-no... B-because of me, the whole world's going to be gone!?
The one who hears the voice of the 'New World' and opens the door to the 'Land of Origin': that is the second Prophet... // You have become that Prophet. Why do you grieve?
Do you not hear it? The 'New World' stirring in the womb, and the people's cries of joy!
[HERO]! K-kill me!!
I figured out how you can become the Devil! // You just have to kill me! If you kill me, you can become the Devil!
Correct. To earn the right to fight God, // one must kill the Prophet, as it is written in the Scriptures.
If it's you, [HERO], I don't mind being killed! So please!!
But until the door to the 'Land of Origin' has opened completely, that cannot be allowed.
I will not kill you. // [HERO]-kun, you still have a task once the door to the 'Land of Origin' has opened: to be the priming water that draws forth the 'New World'.

[HERO], please!!
